title: VITAL Climbing Gym
specs: Multiple NYC locations with varied equipment and amenities
Classes include yoga, Pilates, cycle, fitness, climbing, aerial, and meditation
Participants must be 16+ to attend classes
All users must wear required footwear for climbing (climbing shoes)
All guests must complete a participant agreement
Minors must have participant agreement signed by parent or legal guardian
Groups of 10 or more must notify in advance
Organized group activities require manager approval

options.name: Day Pass
options.detail: Single visit including one class when space allows

options.name: 5-Day Punch Pass
options.detail: 5 visits including one class per visit when space allows

options.name: 10-Day Punch Pass
options.detail: 10 visits including one class per visit when space allows

explain.meaning: Tight, grippy shoes that help you stand on small holds.
Entry for one day, coming and going as you like.

includes: Unlimited classes (yoga, cycle, fitness, climbing, aerial) for members
Access to multiple gym locations for members
blurb: Guests participate in climbing and fitness activities including yoga, Pilates, cycle, aerial, and meditation classes. Memberships provide unlimited classes and access across multiple locations. Day passes and punch passes are available for non-members with limited class access.
extraNote: Monthly memberships renew automatically until cancelled; cancel before billing date via Mindbody account · Annual memberships are prepaid, non-refundable, and convert to monthly after completion · No membership freezing available · Non-members may attend classes only if space is available and cannot reserve online · Day passes and punch passes include one class per visit and must be purchased in person · No running, rough-housing, or jumping off structures; follow staff instructions and posted protocols
